The Masters Tournament does not allow players to enter the first tee box or play with an earbud in their ear, as this violates strict rules regarding electronic devices and equipment.A player at the 2026 Masters would face a penalty for wearing an earbud during tournament play.According to the Rules of Golf (Rule 4.3a(4)), the use of equipment to listen to music or other audio to eliminate distractions or help with swing tempo is prohibited.Penalty for the first breach, it is the General Penalty (two-shot penalty in stroke play).Young should be assessed a two shot penalty!￼3d1Ecommerce BuildingBack nine Sunday at Augusta is where legends are made.
